crossRefs.note: “Now, our God, what shall we say after this? For we have forsaken your commandments,
I will stand at my watch, and set myself on the ramparts, and will look out to see what he will say to me, and what I…
But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath?…
May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Oh, Lord, what shall I say, after Israel has turned their backs before their enemies?
translations.bsb: O Lord, what can I say, now that Israel has turned its back and run from its enemies?
translations.kjv: O Lord, what shall I say, when Israel turneth their backs before their enemies!
translations.asv: Oh, Lord, what shall I say, after that Israel hath turned their backs before their enemies!
